scope: Textures, formats, temporary-image reuse, copy bookkeeping and image transitions; no game-specific settings, full Core build, IPA or release

evidenceLevels.code: Production control flow and extracted methods; final reports authenticate source and generated C++
evidenceLevels.host: GCC 13.3 x86_64 plain and ASan/UBSan adapters, not a Vulkan driver
evidenceLevels.iphone: No new device execution. BO2 artifacts, AC torch flicker and GOW3 freeze are not demonstrated fixed
evidenceLevels.timing: Only copy-input CPU bookkeeping is timed; GPU commands are replaced by recording boundaries

investigations.impact: Correct channel/alpha interpretation when the same Vulkan storage is recycled across guest formats
investigations.evidence: A8R8G8B8 and D8R8G8B8 map to B8G8R8A8_UNORM but have different native alpha mappings. Direct assignment previously left views and m_last_view intact. 6,095 stale selections among exhaustive remaps before, zero after
investigations.change: Use the existing native-layout setter, which retires old views safely and invalidates last-view only if layout changes
investigations.risk: Necessary view replacement when mapping changes; deferred retirement must remain. Unchanged mapping preserves pointer and allocation count

investigations.impact: Reject incompatible 3D allocations after collisions in the compact pool key
investigations.evidence: The key uses depth starting at bit40 and mipmaps at bit48. For example depth512/mips1 and depth256/mips3 collide; both fit valid 3D geometry. The previous lookup checked only hash and usages
investigations.change: Compare actual depth and mipmap count on a candidate hash hit
investigations.risk: Additional scalar comparisons only on pool candidates; correct collisions become misses and may require another image
investigations.verification: 90,005 pool cases jointly cover depth/mips/classes, rejection without removal, bytes and lock lifetime

investigations.impact: Preserve PS3 normalized-versus-float depth semantics when Vulkan format is identical
investigations.evidence: DEPTH24_D8 on a device lacking D24 and DEPTH24_D8_FLOAT both use D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT. Vk image format_class is immutable after construction and selects different pack/unpack compute jobs. It was absent from pool matching
investigations.change: Pass the requested format class at both pool callers and require an exact class match
investigations.risk: Fewer cross-class reuses can increase allocation churn under mixed depth usage, within the existing bounded pool; avoids incorrect conversions
investigations.verification: 2,050 wrong selections in combined original depth/mip/class cases, zero after; mixed-class list keeps rejected candidate for its rightful consumer

investigations.impact: Correct guest width and floating interpretation of cached framebuffer depth
investigations.evidence: Original ternary maps non-z16 to DEPTH16 and z16 to DEPTH24, also drops float variants. The actual accessor returns surface_depth_format2 with four variants and an overloaded comparison to typeless format
investigations.change: Reuse the existing depth-format conversion helper; retain its byte-swap policy
investigations.risk: Changes previously incorrect depth metadata consumed by flush/conversion paths. Color branch, dimensions and ownership remain unchanged
investigations.verification: Eight real enum2 depth/color cases; all four depth formats wrong before and correct after, including z16_float/z24s8_float

investigations.impact: Create presentation conversion storage with transfer-source permission as requested by its real caller
investigations.evidence: VKPresent requests TRANSFER_SRC|SAMPLED, writes a converted image then reads it for presentation. The storage constructor ignored usage_flags and hardcoded only TRANSFER_DST|SAMPLED
investigations.change: OR requested flags with intrinsic TRANSFER_DST|SAMPLED before both pool lookup and image construction
investigations.risk: A fresh presentation image now receives the usage required by its subsequent copy. A pool candidate missing intrinsic DST must be rejected; a superset remains reusable
investigations.verification: Ten cases cover usage combinations0..7 and both pool rejection/superset acceptance; four flag omissions before, zero after

investigations.impact: Remove transient hash nodes and bucket allocations from copies of up to eight sections
investigations.evidence: Every previous nonempty copy constructed an unordered_set and allocated at least a bucket and node. The final generic lambda selects the container once before iteration, using existing inline simple_array for at most eight sections
investigations.change: One written copy/cast/scale body instantiated with inline or unordered source collection; source push/copy order and per-image pop count preserved
investigations.risk: Code size: extracted host bookkeeping grows from 781 to 1,736 bytes including cold paths (+955 B). Complete Vulkan-body and iOS instruction-cache costs are not measured. The final host sample retains an 8.7% regression at 9 distinct sections; all raw trials and previous rejected variants remain available.
investigations.verification: 13,000 generated source sequences; no allocations for at most8 sections; 7 alternating timing trials retained for every case
investigations.hostFinalSummary: At most 8 sections: 2–9 allocations/call become zero; median bookkeeping time decreases 60–86% in final x86_64 sample. At 32/256 sections, final medians improve; no iPhone or total texture-time claim.

investigations.impact: Tested attempt to reduce set work without duplicating loop instantiations
investigations.evidence: insert().second variant regressed some long repeated-source lists. Restoring contains+insert but retaining a runtime branch per iteration still measured a45% regression for256 repeated sections
investigations.change: Both runtime-branch variants removed; source-selection moved outside the loop
investigations.risk: Do not authenticate rejected reports as current production performance

investigations.impact: Avoid a GPU color-clear command when the following copies overwrite every mip and face/depth slice
investigations.evidence: Cube unwrap explicitly supplies every face/mip yet generation always clears. Existing optimization only covered2D mip gathering. Coverage can be proven from full destination rectangles and distinct level/slice identities
investigations.change: A bounded2048-bit coverage check skips the color clear only for complete copies; duplicate, missing, partial, offset, null, depth and oversized cases retain it. force_bg_load and barriers retain their exact order
investigations.risk: Coverage model does not execute GPU typeless/scaled/MSAA copy operations. Their unchanged source bodies were compared and independently reviewed; real Metal behavior needs device execution
investigations.verification: 3,692 cases,657 complete-color cases omit a clear; independently painted destination texels match cleared-then-copied output

investigations.impact: Include vertex texture reads in generic GENERAL and feedback transition scopes
investigations.evidence: The renderer binds vertex textures; SHADER_READ_ONLY and explicit color-resolve barriers already cover vertex+fragment. Four generic GENERAL/feedback branches carried SHADER_READ with only fragment shader stage. Vulkan access scopes are limited by their stage masks
investigations.change: Add VERTEX_SHADER at those four shader-read stage masks; preserve barriers, access flags, queue indices, ranges and renderpass order
investigations.risk: Broader valid graphics synchronization can reduce overlap in those transitions; no throughput gain claimed. No broad compute stage or shader-write flag added
investigations.verification: 7,680 exact barrier-builder calls;1,152 absent vertex scopes before, zero after. Recorded Vulkan API boundary only

investigations.impact: Potential compute read/write hazards around GENERAL layout
investigations.evidence: Color resolve/unresolve uses explicit compute read/write barriers. FSR1 input/intermediate/output and restore barriers are already explicit and byte-identical to baseline. Typeless transport uses transfer barriers. External MetalFX submits and drains the Vulkan/Metal queue handoff
investigations.change: No blanket COMPUTE_SHADER addition to generic transitions
investigations.risk: A broad stage flag would not repair missing SHADER_WRITE access semantics and may be invalid on a noncompute queue. This audit does not prove every future caller safe
investigations.nextEvidence: A specific uncovered compute image producer/consumer sequence, not merely GENERAL layout, is required before changing these barriers

investigations.impact: Possible CPU conversion savings or accuracy defects in packed16-bit-to-BGRA converters
investigations.evidence: The BGRA fallback converter block is selected only by __APPLE__ && ARCH_X64. The iOS ARM64 path selects native16-bit formats instead; optimizing that fallback would not accelerate this target
investigations.change: No change to the inactive x64 fallback; native and hardware-upload paths preserved
investigations.risk: BC decoding/CPU swizzle may still matter when relevant hardware capabilities are absent, but existing traces do not identify the active format distribution
investigations.nextEvidence: Existing device capability/format data or a focused capture proving a specific CPU conversion path is frequent

investigations.impact: A dynamic copy could theoretically retain destination native mapping if its source mapping changes without invalidation
investigations.evidence: Dynamic cache hits update payload only, while clone_surface uses the proper native-layout setter. Normal surface-change notification invalidates overlapping temporary entries; no surviving real sequence was demonstrated where source mapping changes but invalidation is bypassed
investigations.change: No speculative view mutation that could invalidate the common cache's original owning view
investigations.risk: Changing the cached owning view requires accounting for its deferred lifetime; the prior remap wrapper intentionally retains ownership
investigations.nextEvidence: A concrete source replacement/native-layout mutation and deferred descriptor sequence surviving notify_surface_changed

limitations: No iOS/ARM64/Core/IPA compilation, GPU validation layer or gameplay measurement
ASan/UBSan do not model GPU retirement; recorded view lifetimes supplement but do not replace device validation
LeakSanitizer disabled in the host environment; explicit constructed/destroyed view counts match
No claim that any specific BO2, AC or GOW3 symptom is solved
Historical pool527 fixture authenticates its old source/API; new tests replace affected lookup proof rather than replaying that fixed historical fixture

independentReview.initialStableCacheReview: No blocking defect; typeless/scaled/MSAA GPU execution explicitly outside coverage proof
independentReview.rootAdditionalReview: Depth enum2 helper and preservation of intrinsic DST/SAMPLED usage checked
independentReview.finalCacheReview: CPU agent reviewed enum2 depth conversion, intrinsic/requested usage union, template selection and vertex scopes favorably. Template may duplicate the full GPU copy body; bookkeeping size is not a bound on full native code size.
